name: Alexa Arena
description: Alexa Arena is a user-centric simulation platform designed to facilitate research in building assistive conversational embodied agents. It features multi-room layouts and numerous interactable objects, supporting gamified robotic tasks accessible to general users, enabling efficient data collection and evaluation of embodied AI systems through dialog-enabled task completion benchmarks with online human evaluations.
typical_sota_score: Elo ~1500+ (top models as of March 2026; scores continuously evolve)
reputation: A newer benchmark for embodied conversational agents that is gaining attention, but it is not yet as broadly established as long-running embodied AI suites.
notes: Includes a dialog-enabled task completion benchmark with online human evaluations.
